title: Swe entry systemdesign notification system
question: Design a basic system that sends a user an email when a specific event happens in the app, like 'your order shipped'.
idealAnswer:
Separates triggering the event from actually sending the email, e.g. the order-shipped code writes a notification record or publishes an event rather than calling the email provider directly inline

Describes a worker/background job that picks up pending notifications and sends them through an email provider, so a slow email API doesn't block the main request

Handles failure: what happens if the email provider call fails, retry logic or a dead-letter/failed state rather than silently dropping it

Considers duplicate sends, e.g. marking a notification as sent (or using an idempotency check) so a retry or a redeployed worker doesn't email the user twice

Bonus: mentions user preferences, e.g. letting a user opt out of certain notification types, and templating the email content separately from the sending logic
